dlg.role.elder.warm.hello: Welcome to {place}, traveller! I'm {npc}. Sit, eat, stay a while. The soup is hot and the slimes mostly stay in the fields. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.warm.hello: {npc}'s Goods, at your service! Look around, buy something, sell something. My smile is free, the rest has a price.
dlg.role.innkeeper.warm.hello: Ah, a guest! I'm {npc}. The beds are soft and the porridge is only slightly lumpy. Rooms will be ready soon, I promise!
dlg.role.villager.warm.hello: Oh, hello! I'm {npc}. Lovely day in {place}, isn't it? Even the rain feels friendly around here.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.warm.hello: Welcome to the guild desk of {place}! I'm {npc}. Looking for honest work?
quest.board.cull.warm.name: Slimes in the garden
quest.board.cull.warm.journal: Chase off the pests bothering {place}: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.gather.warm.name: Gel for the glue pot
quest.board.gather.warm.journal: The folk of {place} need gel to mend things: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.warm.rumor: They say a stranger from another world will save us all. I hope they bring appetite, we have a lot of pie.
dlg.role.elder.mystic.hello: The trees spoke of your coming to {place}, wanderer. I am {npc}. Listen: in {region} the forest remembers. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.mystic.hello: I am {npc}. What you seek may be on my shelves, or may find you if you pay. The trees do not mind coin.
dlg.role.innkeeper.mystic.hello: {npc} keeps the hearth here. Sleep gently, guest: the branches outside whisper, and they do not always lie.
dlg.role.villager.mystic.hello: Shh... do you hear it? I'm {npc}. The leaves of {place} are telling secrets again.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.mystic.hello: The guild keeps a small light in {place}. I am {npc}. Do you walk the path of work?
quest.board.cull.mystic.name: The restless green ones
quest.board.cull.mystic.journal: Put to rest what drifts near {place}: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.gather.mystic.name: Offerings of gel
quest.board.gather.mystic.journal: Bring the shimmer the forest asks for to {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.mystic.rumor: The old tree at the heart of the wood has not blossomed for nine springs. Something sleeps beneath it.
dlg.role.elder.gruff.hello: {npc}. I run {place}. We dig, we forge, we don't chatter. {quirk} State your business.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.gruff.hello: {npc}. Gear's on the shelves. Prices are on the tags. Don't haggle, it's pointless.
dlg.role.innkeeper.gruff.hello: {npc}. Bed's a bed. Walls are stone, they don't fall down. Don't break anything.
dlg.role.villager.gruff.hello: Hm. {npc}. If you're lost, {place} is the one with the mountain on top.
quest.board.cull.gruff.name: Pest control
quest.board.gather.gruff.name: Gel. Bring it.
dlg.tone.gruff.rumor: Strange tapping from the deep shafts, lately. Not ours. Nobody's down there. Nobody should be.
dlg.role.elder.flowery.hello: Honored guest, jewel of the desert road! I am {npc}, humble keeper of {place}. Water for you, shade for you, and the best prices anywhere! {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.flowery.hello: Ah, the discerning eye! {npc} sells only treasures, and today the treasures are in stock! Look, touch, admire, and buy!
dlg.role.innkeeper.flowery.hello: A traveller! I am {npc}. My rooms are cool, my tea is sweet, and my prices are a gift. Almost a gift.
dlg.role.villager.flowery.hello: Peace and plenty, stranger! I am {npc}. {place} is the pearl of the sands, and I mean it with all my heart.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.flowery.hello: Welcome, welcome to the guild house of {place}! {npc} at your service. Work for a man of your talent?
quest.board.cull.flowery.name: A noble hunt!
quest.board.cull.flowery.journal: Glory awaits near {place}: {target} x{count}, and a fine reward!
quest.board.gather.flowery.name: A treasure of gel!
quest.board.gather.flowery.journal: Gather the finest gel for the merchants of {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.flowery.rumor: A caravan master swears there is an oasis that moves. I swear nothing, but I would follow him.
dlg.role.elder.stoic.hello: I am {npc}. This is {place}. We endure the cold, and the cold endures us. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.stoic.hello: {npc}. Goods. Prices fixed. Winter does not haggle.
dlg.role.innkeeper.stoic.hello: {npc}. A fire, a bed, a bowl. Close the door behind you.
dlg.role.villager.stoic.hello: {npc}. {place} is quiet. We like it that way.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.stoic.hello: {npc}, guild desk of {place}. Work exists. Speak.
quest.board.cull.stoic.name: Slimes
quest.board.gather.stoic.name: Gel
dlg.tone.stoic.rumor: The ice in the old temple groans at night. It has not done that in forty winters.
dlg.role.elder.salty.hello: Ahoy, landlubber! {npc}, harbour-warden o' {place}. Mind the gulls, they bite. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.salty.hello: {npc}'s Chandlery! Rope, hooks, blades an' bandages, all shipshape. Buy it or sell it, matey!
dlg.role.innkeeper.salty.hello: {npc}, at the sign o' the Drowned Boot! Beds don't rock, ale does. Rooms be ready soon enough, har har.
dlg.role.villager.salty.hello: Fair winds, friend! {npc}. {place} smells of fish and freedom, and mostly fish.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.salty.hello: Guild post o' {place}, {npc} at the wheel. Lookin' for a bit o' honest work, sailor?
quest.board.cull.salty.name: Slimes off the starboard!
quest.board.cull.salty.journal: Clear the meadows round {place}, matey: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.gather.salty.name: Gel for the caulking
quest.board.gather.salty.journal: Fetch caulking gel for the docks o' {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.salty.rumor: A lighthouse out on the rocks lit itself last night. The keeper died forty years ago. I'm sayin' nothin'.
dlg.role.elder.grim.hello: I am {npc}. This is {place}. Still standing, which is more than most. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.grim.hello: {npc}. Stock is what survived. Prices are what survival costs.
dlg.role.innkeeper.grim.hello: {npc}. A bed, a roof. Both may collapse. Tonight, probably not.
dlg.role.villager.grim.hello: Ah. A visitor. I am {npc}. {place} thanks you for noticing it. Briefly.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.grim.hello: {npc}, guild desk of {place}. Work is plentiful. Survivors are not.
quest.board.cull.grim.name: Pests
quest.board.gather.grim.name: Gel, while it lasts
quest.board.gather.grim.journal: {place} needs it before winter takes it. {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.grim.rumor: The ash falls upward some nights. We stopped asking why.
dlg.role.elder.scholarly.hello: Ah, a visitor! {npc}, curator of {place}. Welcome, although 'welcome' is, technically, a hypothesis. {quirk}
dlg.role.shopkeeper.scholarly.hello: {npc}, purveyor of instruments and equipment. Prices are listed, annotated and, regrettably, non-negotiable.
dlg.role.innkeeper.scholarly.hello: {npc}. Accommodation, with footnotes. Do mind the third stair; it has a theory about gravity.
dlg.role.villager.scholarly.hello: Fascinating! A new face. I am {npc}. I study {place}. {place} has not yet agreed to be studied.
dlg.role.guild_clerk.scholarly.hello: {npc}, guild registrar of {place}. Employment, in the classical sense. Do you have a moment?
quest.board.cull.scholarly.name: Population control, a field study
quest.board.gather.scholarly.name: Gel specimens for study
quest.board.gather.scholarly.journal: A sample for the scholars of {place}: {target} x{count}.
dlg.tone.scholarly.rumor: A floating island has drifted two degrees off its charted course. Nobody has explained it. Everybody has theories.
quirk.cheese: {place} is famous for its sharp cheese, and for the smell.
quirk.bells: Every house in {place} has a little bell, and each one rings at its own hour.
quirk.bad_luck: {place} has terrible luck. Nobody has ever won a bet here, not even the baker.
quirk.bakers: Folk say {place} has more bakers than roofs.
quirk.singing: In {place} we sing while we work. Badly, but loudly.
quirk.lanterns: At dusk {place} lights a hundred paper lanterns, and a few of them are on fire.
quirk.mushrooms: The mushrooms of {place} glow at night. Eat them and you will, too. Briefly.
quirk.kites: Children in {place} fly kites tied to the chickens. The chickens have stopped objecting.
quirk.honey: The honey of {place} is sold three valleys away, and the bees want a word with you about it.
quirk.riddles: In {place} nobody answers a question directly. Why do you ask?
quirk.cats: There are more cats than people in {place}. The cats know it.
quirk.bridges: {place} has eleven bridges and only one river, and we are quite proud of the arithmetic.
dlg.role.errand.ask: Is there anything I can do for you?
dlg.errand.warm.offer: The slimes have grown bold around the fields, and the cartwheels stick in their gel. Thin them out for us, will you? And bring a little gel back: the cooper uses it for seals.
dlg.errand.warm.busy: The fields are not safe yet. Take your time, but take bread too.
dlg.errand.warm.thanks: The carts roll free again. Take this, with the thanks of the whole village.
dlg.errand.mystic.offer: At night the shade wolves circle the village and the lanterns gutter. The wisps they shed burn gently and keep the dark honest. Hunt a few, and bring me four wisps.
dlg.errand.mystic.busy: The lanterns are still low. The wolves are patient, so be more patient than they are.
dlg.errand.mystic.thanks: The lanterns burn steady and the dark keeps its distance. The forest remembers kindness; take this.
dlg.errand.gruff.offer: Slate slimes are eating the cart roads from underneath. We need the roads and the shards for the smith. Six slimes, five shards. Don't make a speech of it.
dlg.errand.gruff.busy: Roads are still half gone. Less talk, more slimes.
dlg.errand.gruff.thanks: Good. The carts get through. Here is your pay, and my hand on it.
dlg.errand.flowery.offer: The sand slimes are trampling the flower terraces! Drive them away, dear traveler, and fetch some gel: it is the best thing in the world for the roots.
dlg.errand.flowery.busy: The terraces are still in a state. Please be quick, the blooms will not wait for the summer.
dlg.errand.flowery.thanks: The terraces are in bloom again, and it is thanks to you! Take this with all our gratitude.
dlg.errand.stoic.offer: Winter takes the weak. We need pelts. Six wolves, four pelts. It is not much to ask, nor to give.
dlg.errand.stoic.busy: The cold does not wait. Neither should we.
dlg.errand.stoic.thanks: The village will be warm. That is enough. Take this.
dlg.errand.salty.offer: The tide slimes foul the nets, and the pearls they carry would pay the boat's debts. Clear the shallows and bring me five pearls, and a bit of the sea is yours.
dlg.errand.salty.busy: The nets are still full of slime, friend. Mind the tide, it turns.
dlg.errand.salty.thanks: The nets come up clean and the boat is paid. Here, a share of the catch.
dlg.errand.grim.offer: The ember slimes burn the grain. Their cores keep our furnaces. Kill six, bring four cores. Do not touch them barehanded.
dlg.errand.grim.busy: The furnace is cooling. Do not come back empty-handed.
dlg.errand.grim.thanks: The furnace roars and the grain is safe. I do not thank often. Take this.
dlg.errand.scholarly.offer: The glow slimes shed star dust, and the Archive needs a survey of it. Cull five and gather five measures. Mind the margins, and do not spill.
dlg.errand.scholarly.busy: The survey is incomplete, and the Archive is patient only in theory.
dlg.errand.scholarly.thanks: A tidy result, and in good time. The Archive thanks you and so do I. Please accept this.
quest.board.purge.warm.name: A proper clear-out
quest.board.purge.warm.journal: The pests of {place} have multiplied; thin them out in numbers: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.mystic.name: The long vigil
quest.board.purge.mystic.journal: A great many stir around {place}; settle them all: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.gruff.name: Clear the shafts
quest.board.purge.gruff.journal: {place} wants it done properly this time: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.flowery.name: A bouquet of trouble
quest.board.purge.flowery.journal: {place} is overrun, dear; please make some room: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.stoic.name: Winter culling
quest.board.purge.stoic.journal: {place} needs fewer of them before the snow: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.salty.name: Bailing out the shallows
quest.board.purge.salty.journal: The shallows near {place} are thick with them: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.grim.name: Burn them back
quest.board.purge.grim.journal: {place} will pay for a real purge: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.purge.scholarly.name: A statistically significant cull
quest.board.purge.scholarly.journal: The Archive of {place} requires a sample of considerable size: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.stockpile.warm.name: A full larder
quest.board.stockpile.warm.journal: {place} is stocking up for winter; bring plenty: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.stockpile.mystic.name: Heaped offerings
quest.board.stockpile.mystic.journal: {place} asks for a great store of it: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.stockpile.gruff.name: Bulk order
quest.board.stockpile.flowery.name: A basket to overflow
quest.board.stockpile.stoic.name: Stores for the dark months
quest.board.stockpile.salty.name: A hold full
quest.board.stockpile.salty.journal: The boats of {place} need a full hold: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.stockpile.grim.name: Fuel for the long burn
quest.board.stockpile.grim.journal: {place} will take all you can carry: {target} x{count}.
quest.board.stockpile.scholarly.name: Bulk specimens
quest.board.stockpile.scholarly.journal: The Archive of {place} wants a substantial collection: {target} x{count}.
dlg.role.pantry.ask: Anything you need around the inn?
dlg.tone.warm.legend: They say the old barrow north-west of the start keeps a warden who never sleeps, and the cellar north-east floods with slimes whenever the Gel King wants company. Most folk here keep to the road.
dlg.pantry.warm.offer: The regulars say the taproom needs a trophy. Four wolf fangs over the door would do nicely, and the grey wolves around the old dungeons have plenty. Mind the dark corners.
dlg.pantry.warm.busy: Four fangs, over the door. Take your time, the door is not going anywhere.
dlg.pantry.warm.thanks: Look at that! The regulars will talk about it for a month. Here, a little something for the road.
dlg.tone.mystic.legend: In the deepest part of the Whisperwood there is a ring of trees with only one gap. The shade wolves obey whatever stands in the middle. Those who go in at dusk come back quiet.
dlg.pantry.mystic.offer: I would like three dire fangs. Do not ask what for; it has to do with a candle and a promise. The great wolves of the deep forest carry them.
dlg.pantry.mystic.busy: Three dire fangs. The candle burns lower every night.
dlg.pantry.mystic.thanks: The candle is lit, the promise kept. Thank you, wanderer. Take this.
dlg.tone.gruff.legend: Old mine at Ironspine. Sealed. The foreman is still in there, swinging a maul that rings like a bell. The smiths would like that maul. None of them would like to fetch it.
dlg.pantry.gruff.offer: Ten slate shards. New bar top. The old one is split. Slate slimes drop them, if you like hitting things.
dlg.pantry.gruff.busy: Ten shards. I am still counting.
dlg.pantry.gruff.thanks: Good shards. Flat, hard. The bar will outlast us both. Here.
dlg.tone.flowery.legend: Out in the dunes there is a stepped tower of golden stone, with the gate on the wrong side of every wall. You will walk in circles until the Sentinel finds you. Lovely view from the top, I have heard.
dlg.pantry.flowery.offer: I want to hang amber in the front window, so the evening sun comes through it like honey! Five drops should do. The amber slimes carry them, I am told, and they are quite cross about it.
dlg.pantry.flowery.busy: Five drops of amber, dear. The window still looks so bare.
dlg.pantry.flowery.thanks: Oh, look at the light! You have made the whole room golden. Please, take this.
dlg.tone.stoic.legend: Under the glaciers there is a cavern that breathes cold. A revenant keeps it. The wind there speaks, and what it says is: turn back.
dlg.pantry.stoic.offer: The cellar needs cold that lasts through summer. Four ice crystals will keep it. The slimes in the frozen places carry them.
dlg.pantry.stoic.busy: Four crystals. The cellar is warming.
dlg.pantry.stoic.thanks: The cellar holds. The meat will keep. Take this.
dlg.tone.salty.legend: At low tide a temple comes up out of the bay, all green stone and weed. A Regent sits in the apse. The fishers say the pearls come from his crown. Fishers say a lot.
dlg.pantry.salty.offer: The old inn sign rotted off its chain. I want a new one, made of coral from the slimes in the shallows. Five bits ought to do it. Mind the tide.
dlg.pantry.salty.busy: Five bits of coral. I will make a sign worth looking up at.
dlg.pantry.salty.thanks: A fine sign it will be. The ships will see it from the bay. Here, for your trouble.
dlg.tone.grim.legend: A citadel burned a century ago, east in the ash. Its forges burn again. Something black walks the courtyard. The ash remembers every footstep that went in.
dlg.pantry.grim.offer: The hearth has gone out for the first time in forty years. Three magma shards will light it again for forty more. The magma slimes carry them. Do not hold them for long.
dlg.pantry.grim.busy: Three shards. The room is cold. So am I.
dlg.pantry.grim.thanks: It burns. I had forgotten how the walls look when it burns. Take this.
dlg.tone.scholarly.legend: The old observatory was built to catalogue the stars. Its Curator now catalogues visitors. The Archive has stopped lending books to anyone who has been inside.
dlg.pantry.scholarly.offer: I am told a storm feather glows steadily for decades in a lamp. Three would make the common room read-worthy again. The storm wolves of these parts carry them, rather reluctantly.
dlg.pantry.scholarly.busy: Three storm feathers. The common room remains regrettably dim.
dlg.pantry.scholarly.thanks: A remarkable glow, and so steady. Several patrons have already begun to read. Thank you; please take this.
dlg.craft.warm.info: Monster parts? Bring me wolf fang x8 and slime gel x12 and I will make you a Fang dagger. Nothing fancy, but it will outlast you.
dlg.craft.warm.done: There. Go and cut something worth cutting.
dlg.tone.warm.road: North and east the road forks at the old stones. Wake every Threshold Stone you pass; it is a long way back otherwise.
dlg.craft.mystic.info: The wisps want to be something. Bring me shade wisp x6 and dire fang x3 and I will give them a shape: a Wisp mantle.
dlg.craft.mystic.done: It is done. The wisps are quiet now. Wear it kindly.
dlg.tone.mystic.road: Keep to the dirt road when the fog comes. The edge of the forest shifts at night; the lamps do not.
dlg.craft.gruff.info: Slate shard x14 and wolf fang x6. I make you a Slate cleaver. No haggling.
dlg.craft.gruff.done: Done. Take it. Do not drop it on your foot.
dlg.tone.gruff.road: Roads up here wash out every spring. Bring bread. Carry a spare boot.
dlg.craft.flowery.info: Oh, I would love to! Bring me amber drop x8 and slime gel x10 and I will make you an Amber plate, and I will even add a ribbon.
dlg.craft.flowery.done: Beautiful! Wear it in good health, and come back to tell me about the adventures.
dlg.tone.flowery.road: The dunes move, but the stone markers do not. Walk from marker to marker and you will never be lost, only late.
dlg.craft.stoic.info: Frost pelt x8 and ice crystal x4. A Frostfur coat. It will keep you alive. That is the whole offer.
dlg.tone.stoic.road: Snow hides the road, not the stones. Follow the stones.
dlg.craft.salty.info: Bring me tide pearl x6 and coral fragment x8, friend, and I will turn them into a Pearl rapier. The sea sends the parts; I only do the work.
dlg.craft.salty.done: Fair winds to you and your new gear.
dlg.tone.salty.road: The coast road floods at the full moon. Walk it at the ebb, or take a boat and a prayer.
dlg.craft.grim.info: Bring ember core x8 and magma shard x5. I will forge an Ember greatsword. Do not stand too close while I work.
dlg.craft.grim.done: It is hot. Let it cool, then go and make me proud.
dlg.tone.grim.road: Ash fills the ruts. A cart passes once a week, if it is brave.
dlg.craft.scholarly.info: A commission! Bring me star dust x8 and storm feather x4 and I shall produce a Starlit vestment, with notes.
dlg.craft.scholarly.done: Finished, and footnoted. I do hope you will return the favor with a story.
dlg.tone.scholarly.road: The road to Lumeria is straight, flat and signposted. Everyone still gets lost; the signs are in Old Lumerian.
dlg.role.craft.ask: Could you make something from monster parts?
dlg.role.craft.make: Here are the parts. Make it.
dlg.role.road: How is the road around here?
dlg.hunt.warm.offer: You did well with the meadows. Now, there is something that frightens even the cooper: a slime with a crown, in the cellar north-east of here. They call it the Gel King. Could you see to it?
dlg.hunt.warm.busy: The Gel King is still wearing his crown. Mind the flood in the cellar.
dlg.hunt.warm.thanks: The crown is gone, and the cellar is only damp. You are a credit to us. Here, for the trouble.
dlg.hunt.mystic.offer: You have eased the lanterns; now ease the dark. In the deepest ring of trees a silver-black wolf leads the pack. It is not hunger that drives it. Will you face it?
dlg.hunt.mystic.busy: The Alpha is still out there. The forest holds its breath.
dlg.hunt.mystic.thanks: The forest breathes again. The pack scatters and the lanterns burn clean. Take this, with thanks.
dlg.hunt.gruff.offer: Dire wolves have a den in the foothills. A big one leads them. Cull it and the rest scatter. Pay is fair.
dlg.hunt.gruff.busy: The Alpha still runs the den. Go.
dlg.hunt.gruff.thanks: The den is quiet. Roads are safe. Good work. Pay.
dlg.hunt.flowery.offer: Oh, there is a Queen in the dunes, and she is cross! A great amber slime, in a hollow of rocks, and every slime in the sand obeys her. Would you speak to her, with your sword?
dlg.hunt.flowery.busy: The Queen still sits in her hollow, I am afraid. Do be careful, dear.
dlg.hunt.flowery.thanks: The sand is calm and the terraces are safe again! You are a marvel. Please, accept this.
dlg.hunt.stoic.offer: There is a pit in the ice, and a warden in it. The slimes do as he wills. He must go before the thaw.
dlg.hunt.stoic.busy: The Warden holds the pit. It is cold. Go on.
dlg.hunt.stoic.thanks: The pit is empty. The thaw may come. Take this.
dlg.hunt.salty.offer: A coral slime the size of a cart sits in the grotto up the coast, and the little ones pour out of her at every tide. Take her down, friend, and the bay is ours again.
dlg.hunt.salty.busy: The Matron still sits in her grotto. The tide is rising, mind your feet.
dlg.hunt.salty.thanks: The grotto is quiet and the bay is clear. The ships are ours again. Here, a share of everything.
dlg.hunt.grim.offer: There is a vent in the ash, and at its heart something that beats. It feeds the slimes and they feed the fires. Put it out.
dlg.hunt.grim.busy: The heart still beats. The ash is warm and it should not be.
dlg.hunt.grim.thanks: The vent is cold. First time in a hundred years. Take this and do not speak of it.
dlg.hunt.scholarly.offer: The Archive has a request: a storm wolf of unusual size leads a roost on the plain, and our weather records have gone mad. Remove it, and the data will behave. Will you?
dlg.hunt.scholarly.busy: The Sovereign is still at large; the weather records remain unreliable.
dlg.hunt.scholarly.thanks: The records are perfectly dull again. A triumph! The Archive thanks you, and so do I.
dlg.inn.warm.bed: A warm bed for the night (8 gold)
dlg.inn.warm.slept: You wake with the sun in your face and bread on the air. Feeling like new!
dlg.inn.warm.poor: A bed is 8 gold, dear, and I can see you are short. Come back when the road has been kinder.
dlg.inn.warm.fed: Wrapped in a cloth, still warm. Eat it before it gets cold.
dlg.inn.mystic.bed: A bed in the quiet room (12 gold)
dlg.inn.mystic.slept: You sleep without dreams and wake with the lamps still lit. Whole again.
dlg.inn.mystic.poor: The quiet room is 12 gold. You do not have it. The forest will provide, but not tonight.
dlg.inn.mystic.meal: A bowl for the road (50 gold)
dlg.inn.mystic.fed: The pot is warm. May it carry you.
dlg.inn.gruff.slept: Hard mattress, thick walls. You are whole again. Do not thank me.
dlg.inn.gruff.poor: 10 gold. You do not have it. Floor is free, but cold.
dlg.inn.flowery.slept: You wake among petals, rested to your toes! What a lovely morning.
dlg.inn.flowery.poor: A sunny room is 14 gold, dear, and I am afraid you are a little short. Come back, I will keep it warm.
dlg.inn.flowery.fed: A little ribbon on top! Enjoy.
dlg.inn.stoic.bed: A bed by the stove (12 gold)
dlg.inn.stoic.slept: You sleep. You wake. You are mended.
dlg.inn.stoic.poor: 12 gold for the bed. You are short. Return when you are not.
dlg.inn.salty.bed: A bunk for the night (12 gold)
dlg.inn.salty.slept: You wake to gulls and a mended body. The bunk rocks, somehow, though it is on land.
dlg.inn.salty.poor: A bunk is 12 gold, friend, and your purse is lighter than that. Come back when the nets are full.
dlg.inn.salty.fed: Wrapped in kelp. Keeps for days.
dlg.inn.grim.bed: A cot for the night (16 gold)
dlg.inn.grim.slept: You sleep like the dead and wake as the living. The cot held.
dlg.inn.grim.poor: 16 gold. Not in your pocket. The ash is free, if you do not mind the taste.
dlg.inn.grim.fed: Dry, but it will keep you walking.
dlg.inn.scholarly.bed: A room with a reading lamp (18 gold)
dlg.inn.scholarly.slept: You wake having read two chapters in your sleep, and fully recovered. A fine night.
dlg.inn.scholarly.poor: A room is 18 gold, and the purse, regrettably, says otherwise. Do return when the numbers favor you.
dlg.inn.scholarly.fed: Labelled and dated. Enjoy, with notes.
dlg.comm.warm.offer1: The slimes are at the cooper's again. Hunt green slime x10, then bring me slime gel x8 for the proof.
dlg.comm.warm.offer2: Folks say the mint slimes make the best tea. Hunt mint slime x10 and bring mint leaf x8. I will brew a pot.
dlg.comm.warm.offer3: Tawny wolves are testing the sheep fences. Hunt tawny wolf x8 and bring tawny fur x6, and the shepherds will be in your debt.
dlg.comm.warm.busy: The commission stands. Take your time, and your bread.
dlg.comm.warm.thanks: Well done! The guild remembers, and so does the whole village. Here is your share.
dlg.gossip.warm.1: The baker swears the Gel King is just lonely.
dlg.gossip.warm.2: Somebody is feeding the slimes. Nobody will admit it.
dlg.gossip.warm.3: My cousin says the barrow warden snores. My cousin has never been there.
dlg.comm.mystic.offer1: The shade wolves crowd the lantern road. Hunt shade wolf x8, then bring me shade wisp x6 to keep the lanterns lit.
dlg.comm.mystic.offer2: Moss slimes hush the forest paths, and that is not natural. Hunt moss slime x10 and bring moss clump x8.
dlg.comm.mystic.offer3: Dire wolves have joined the pack. Hunt dire wolf x6 and bring dire fang x5. Do not go alone at dusk.
dlg.comm.mystic.busy: The forest is still listening. Finish what you started.
dlg.comm.mystic.thanks: The paths are quiet, and kind again. Take this, with the forest's thanks.
dlg.gossip.mystic.1: The wisps are brighter this month. I do not like it.
dlg.gossip.mystic.2: Last night the trees rearranged themselves. By morning they pretended otherwise.
dlg.gossip.mystic.3: A stranger asked me the way to a place that does not exist. I told him.
dlg.comm.gruff.offer1: Slate slimes on the road. Hunt slate slime x10. Bring slate shard x8. No speeches.
dlg.comm.gruff.offer2: Rust slimes eat the rails. Hunt rust slime x10. Bring rust flake x8.
dlg.comm.gruff.offer3: Dire wolves on the pass. Hunt dire wolf x6. Bring dire fang x5. Pay is good.
dlg.comm.gruff.busy: Not done. Get on with it.
dlg.gossip.gruff.1: The foreman's maul rings in the deep. We say it is the wind.
dlg.gossip.gruff.2: The bridge toll went up. So did the bridge.
dlg.gossip.gruff.3: A dwarf came by looking for his forge. We said we had not seen it.
dlg.comm.flowery.offer1: Sand slimes in the gardens again, dear! Hunt sand slime x10, then bring slime gel x8 for the flowerbeds.
dlg.comm.flowery.offer2: It is amber season and the slimes are most unruly. Hunt amber slime x8 and bring amber drop x6, if you please.
dlg.comm.flowery.offer3: The dune wolves are bold this year. Hunt dune wolf x8 and bring dune pelt x6 for the weavers.
dlg.comm.flowery.busy: Still at it, dear? Do take care of yourself.
dlg.comm.flowery.thanks: Marvelous! The guild is delighted, and so am I. Please accept this.
dlg.gossip.flowery.1: The bees refuse the cactus flowers this year. Very rude of them.
dlg.gossip.flowery.2: Someone left a sandcastle in the market square. It has a flag.
dlg.gossip.flowery.3: They say the ziggurat sings at midnight. I have never stayed up to check.
dlg.comm.stoic.offer1: Frost wolves come down with the first snow. Hunt frost wolf x8. Bring frost pelt x6.
dlg.comm.stoic.offer2: The ice slimes carry crystals that the cellars need. Hunt ice slime x8. Bring ice crystal x6.
dlg.comm.stoic.offer3: Polar wolves, bigger than the rest. Hunt polar wolf x8. Bring polar fur x6. Come back.
dlg.comm.stoic.busy: The work stands. So does the winter.
dlg.comm.stoic.thanks: Done. The village will last the winter. Take this.
dlg.gossip.stoic.1: The wind spoke last night. Nobody answered.
dlg.gossip.stoic.2: A caravan went north in autumn. It is spring.
dlg.gossip.stoic.3: The ice has a new crack. Everyone has an opinion.
dlg.comm.salty.offer1: The tide slimes foul the beach again. Hunt tide slime x10, friend, and bring tide pearl x6.
dlg.comm.salty.offer2: The reef is thick with coral slimes. Hunt coral slime x8 and bring me coral fragment x6.
dlg.comm.salty.offer3: It is pearl season, and the pearl slimes are everywhere. Hunt pearl slime x8 and bring pearl dust x6.
dlg.comm.salty.busy: The tide is turning, friend. Finish before it does.
dlg.comm.salty.thanks: A fair catch! The guild thanks you. Here, your share.
dlg.gossip.salty.1: A fisher swears he caught a boot with a message in it.
dlg.gossip.salty.2: The harbormaster counts the ships twice. The second count is always lower.
dlg.gossip.salty.3: They say the galleon has a captain who sends his regards, and wants his ship back.
dlg.comm.grim.offer1: Ember slimes in the grain again. Hunt ember slime x10 and bring ember core x6.
dlg.comm.grim.offer2: The magma slimes have come up with the heat. Hunt magma slime x8. Bring magma shard x5. Wear gloves.
dlg.comm.grim.offer3: Char slimes in the old furnaces. Hunt char slime x8, bring char chunk x6. Do not breathe the smoke.
dlg.comm.grim.busy: Unfinished. The ash waits for no one.
dlg.comm.grim.thanks: Finished. The guild notes it. Take this.
dlg.gossip.grim.1: The ash is warmer on the east side.
dlg.gossip.grim.2: A trader refused to come back through the pass. He left his cart.
dlg.gossip.grim.3: We keep one lamp burning all night. Nobody asks why.
dlg.comm.scholarly.offer1: The Archive requires a survey: hunt glow slime x8, then bring star dust x6 for the samples.
dlg.comm.scholarly.offer2: Storm wolves disturb the instruments. Hunt storm wolf x6 and bring storm feather x5. Handle with care.
dlg.comm.scholarly.offer3: The nebula slimes are rare and the Archive is eager. Hunt nebula slime x8, bring nebula ash x6, and do keep the samples dry.
dlg.comm.scholarly.busy: The survey is incomplete, and the Archive is, as always, patient only in theory.
dlg.comm.scholarly.thanks: A thorough result. The Archive thanks you, and so do I. Accept this.
dlg.gossip.scholarly.1: The Archive lost a book yesterday. It was not misplaced; it left.
dlg.gossip.scholarly.2: A scholar claims the stars here are two percent closer. We are checking.
dlg.gossip.scholarly.3: The observatory curator has stopped answering letters. The letters have started answering back.
dlg.role.season: How is the season treating you?
dlg.role.night: Any tales for a dark night?
dlg.season.warm.spring: The meadows are green again, and the slimes are back in the beans.
dlg.season.warm.summer: Long days, warm evenings. We eat outside until the stars come out.
dlg.season.warm.autumn: Harvest time! Every cart is full, and every cooper is cross.
dlg.season.warm.winter: Snow on the roofs and soup on the stove. Not a bad bargain.
dlg.night.warm: They say that on moonless nights the Gel King walks the cellar stairs, looking for his crown. He never finds it. It is on his head.
dlg.season.mystic.spring: The wisps wake with the buds. The forest hums, if you stand still.
dlg.season.mystic.summer: The nights are short and the dark is shy. The lanterns hardly matter.
dlg.season.mystic.autumn: Leaves fall in patterns. Read them, if you dare.
dlg.season.mystic.winter: The forest sleeps, and sleeping things dream. Do not walk through the dreams.
dlg.night.mystic: A lantern once walked into the forest by itself, and came back with a note. The note said: thank you.
dlg.season.gruff.spring: Thaw. Roads wash out. Bring boots.
dlg.season.gruff.summer: Good for stonework. Bad for tempers.
dlg.season.gruff.autumn: Stocking up. Every shaft, every store.
dlg.season.gruff.winter: Snow in the pass. Nobody comes, nobody goes. Quiet.
dlg.night.gruff: Hammering in the shafts, nights. We call it the second shift.
dlg.season.flowery.spring: The terraces are in bloom! Pink, white and a very rude orange.
dlg.season.flowery.summer: The sand is hot enough to cook on, and the evenings are heaven.
dlg.season.flowery.autumn: Seeds, seeds everywhere. The wind is a gardener.
dlg.season.flowery.winter: Cold nights, warm blankets. Even the cacti look cozy.
dlg.night.flowery: On the longest night the dunes sing. Close the shutters and listen. It is gorgeous and a little frightening.
dlg.season.stoic.spring: The ice cracks. It is loud. It is also good.
dlg.season.stoic.summer: A week of sun. We do not trust it.
dlg.season.stoic.autumn: First frost. The wolves come down. We are ready.
dlg.night.stoic: A wolf stood at the door once and looked at us. We looked back. By dawn it had gone. Nobody speaks of it.
dlg.season.salty.spring: The tide is high and the fish are fat.
dlg.season.salty.summer: Warm water, bright sails, and everyone is sunburned.
dlg.season.salty.autumn: Storms on the coast. The harbor holds. Mostly.
dlg.season.salty.winter: The nets freeze to the pier. We drink to them.
dlg.night.salty: The galleon's bell rings on still nights. Do not row out to answer it.
dlg.season.grim.spring: Rain washes the ash into the ditches. The ground is gray mud.
dlg.season.grim.summer: Hot. Hotter than usual. Do not stand near the furnaces.
dlg.season.grim.autumn: Embers fall like leaves. Watch your hair.
dlg.season.grim.winter: The only season the ash is cold.
dlg.night.grim: A light in the citadel, every seventh night. Nobody has gone to see. Nobody will.
dlg.season.scholarly.spring: The migrations begin. The Archive counts everything that flies.
dlg.season.scholarly.summer: Long days, perfect light: excellent for observations.
dlg.season.scholarly.autumn: The leaves fall at exactly the rate our model predicted. Pleasing.
dlg.season.scholarly.winter: Early nights and long reading. The best of all seasons.
dlg.night.scholarly: Every star has a footnote. Tonight I shall tell you about the saddest one.
dlg.seasonal.warm.offer: It is harvest, and the cart needs filling: mint to flavor the cider, and tawny fur to wrap the jars. Bring me some, and the whole village eats tonight.
dlg.seasonal.warm.busy: The cart is half empty. Take your time, but not all of autumn.
dlg.seasonal.warm.thanks: The cart is full and the cider is sweet! Take this, with the whole village's thanks.
dlg.seasonal.warm.wait: Harvest is a thing for autumn, dear. Come back when the leaves turn.
dlg.seasonal.mystic.offer: Every spring the wisps bloom, and the forest needs spore and light to carry the bloom. Bring me wisps and caps, and I will light the first lantern of the year.
dlg.seasonal.mystic.busy: The bloom waits, but not forever.
dlg.seasonal.mystic.thanks: The bloom is open. Look: the whole forest glows. Take this.
dlg.seasonal.mystic.wait: The bloom is a spring thing. Return with the first buds.
dlg.seasonal.gruff.offer: Winter. Stores need patching. Slate and rust, ten and six. Quick.
dlg.seasonal.gruff.thanks: Stores hold. You did well. Pay.
dlg.seasonal.flowery.offer: The Festival of Petals is coming, and we need amber for the lanterns and spore caps for the garlands! Oh, do help, dear traveler!
dlg.seasonal.flowery.busy: The festival is almost here, dear! Do hurry.
dlg.seasonal.flowery.thanks: It is the loveliest festival we have ever had, and it is thanks to you! Please, this is for you.
dlg.seasonal.flowery.wait: The festival is only in spring, dear. Come back with the first petals.
dlg.seasonal.stoic.offer: Summer is short. We store. Pelts and fur: six and four. Then winter can come.
dlg.seasonal.stoic.busy: The summer ends. The work stands.
dlg.seasonal.stoic.thanks: The stores are full. Winter can come. Take this.
dlg.seasonal.salty.offer: The storms come in autumn, and the boats need mending: shell for the hulls, pearls for the lamps. Bring them, friend, and you will sleep soundly.
dlg.seasonal.salty.busy: The sky darkens, friend. Be quick about it.
dlg.seasonal.salty.thanks: The boats are ready and the lamps are bright. Let the storm come. Take your share.
dlg.seasonal.salty.wait: Storm work is autumn work. Come back when the gulls go quiet.
dlg.seasonal.grim.offer: In winter the ash is cold, and so are we. Cores and chunks keep the furnaces from dying. Six and five. Do not be late.
dlg.seasonal.grim.thanks: The furnaces hold. Winter is survivable. Take this.
dlg.seasonal.grim.wait: Winter work. The cold has not come yet.
dlg.seasonal.scholarly.offer: The solstice is the best light of the year for the instruments. I need star dust and nebula ash: six and four. Do bring them dry.
dlg.seasonal.scholarly.busy: The solstice will not wait for the survey. Hurry, please.
dlg.seasonal.scholarly.thanks: The observations are excellent! The Archive will remember you in the footnotes. Take this.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.warm.known: Oh, it's you! {place} talks about you, you know. For a friend the prices shrink a little. Don't tell the others.
dlg.role.elder.warm.known: There's our helper! {place} sleeps better since you came. Sit, sit. The porridge is nearly lump-free today.
dlg.role.innkeeper.warm.known: A bed for the one who helps {place}? On the house. The lumpy porridge too.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.mystic.known: The trees have spoken your name, and kindly. My shelves lean toward you; so do my prices.
dlg.role.elder.mystic.known: The forest remembers what you did for {place}. It rarely remembers anything good. Be proud.
dlg.role.innkeeper.mystic.known: Rest, friend of {place}. Tonight the branches will whisper only nice things. I asked them.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.gruff.known: You. You did good work round here. Prices are lower for you. Don't make it a thing.
dlg.role.elder.gruff.known: {place} owes you. We don't say that often. We won't say it twice.
dlg.role.innkeeper.gruff.known: Bed's free for you. You earned it. Still don't break anything.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.flowery.known: The hero of {place}! For you, my treasures are almost a gift, and this time I nearly mean it!
dlg.role.elder.flowery.known: Ah, the name the caravans carry! {place} sings of you, slightly off key, with great feeling!
dlg.role.innkeeper.flowery.known: For the friend of {place}: my coolest room, my sweetest tea, and no bill. I shall weep later, in private.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.stoic.known: You helped {place}. Lower prices. That is how we say thanks.
dlg.role.elder.stoic.known: {place} knows your name. Here, that is a long speech.
dlg.role.innkeeper.stoic.known: A bed. No coin. You are known here.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.salty.known: Well blow me down, the friend o' {place}! Crew's prices for ye, matey!
dlg.role.elder.salty.known: Har! The whole dock o' {place} drinks to yer name. Mostly they just drink, but still.
dlg.role.innkeeper.salty.known: A bunk for a shipmate o' {place}, no charge! The ale's still extra, I ain't mad.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.grim.known: You helped. Few do. {place} lowers its prices for you, while there are prices.
dlg.role.elder.grim.known: {place} still stands, and partly because of you. Enjoy it. Things rarely last.
dlg.role.innkeeper.grim.known: A bed, free. You kept the roof up one more night. Seems fair.
dlg.role.shopkeeper.scholarly.known: Ah, the person cited in three separate complaints that turned out to be compliments. A discount applies; see footnote.
dlg.role.elder.scholarly.known: Your contribution to {place} is, I am told, statistically significant. We are grateful, within error bars.
dlg.role.innkeeper.scholarly.known: Complimentary accommodation, for services rendered to {place}. The third stair sends its regards.
dlg.role.friend_bed: A bed for a friend of the town?
dlg.seasonal.scholarly.wait: The solstice is in summer. Do return then; the instruments are not ready.
